role: Places paintings and item frames: on a side face 2-5 it builds the hanging entity for the facing direction, checks onValidSurface and spawns it.

members.name: hangingEntityClass
members.note: fallhang.c distinguishes the painting kind (with its EnumArt choice) from the item frame

members.name: onItemUse
members.note: the side 0/1 refusal, the Direction.facingToDirection map, canPlayerEdit, the onValidSurface check, the spawn and the stack decrement

members.name: createHangingEntity
members.note: the EntityPainting constructor with its art loop, and the item frame constructor, both in fallhang.c

notes: The item frame's onItemUse runs on both sides: the server builds and spawns it (serverreplay_place_hanging), the client spends its constructor draws and checks onValidSurface on its own copies (pickobj_client_hanging_fits); the top and bottom faces answer false. details-frames-s1 places two frames and clicks a floor top. persist-hanging-s1 and test_fallhang.c gate the validity tick and the drop when broken. lane/idxblocks: the painting (321) now hangs through the same path (survival.c, serverreplay.c:serverreplay_place_hanging with FH_PAINTING, the client's pickobj_client_hanging_fits running the art loop against its own hanging copies); idx-painting-s1 hangs five paintings side by side, refuses a floor top, a frame beside them, and breaks one. lane/villagetrade 2026-09-27: the tail-only evidence (X-01/X-02) now points at the full re-records persist-hanging-full-s1, whose native replay starts before the behaviour.
